result.summary: The page is largely visually coherent. One minor content-formatting issue is visible in the promotional banner.

issues.description: The promo banner uses the awkward phrase “min. order €10” and a tightly spaced separator (“checkout · min. order €10”), which reads like unfinished or poorly localized copy.
issues.suggestion: Use clearer localized wording and spacing, such as “Use code TALLINN3 at checkout. Minimum order: €10.”
